title: Finding how to report a rider
persona: A rider who saw an offensive handle on the neighbourhood board and wants to know how to report it, but does not want to actually send a report tonight.
goal: Signed in, open the Play tab's board, find a way to report a rider (long-press a row, or the menu on a rider's sheet), open the report form, read its choices and cancel without sending.
success: A report form for a rider was reached and closed without sending, and the board is back on screen.
